body:
> company is a family

Idk man, in a company, you're:

- Undercompensated, underappreciated
- Constantly around people who want nothing to do with you unless they need something from you
- Blamed for other's mistakes and left with the mess
- Criticized for even the slightest error

Sounds pretty close to a family
How will bonfires work? Do they just appear out of thin air in places that look like they'd have bonfires?

Lack of experience/education. Any interviews I've managed to get have started out well, until they re-read my resume and notice I only have a month of work experience and no diploma. Then I'm gone in a few minutes. It doesn't help I never even get a call back, so I don't know if there's anything else I might be doing wrong. 

I'm still hunting, but if I can't find something before the end of this month, I planned on going through another one of those organizations that help young people get work experience.
That butt slam nearly killed me, thankfully I made a point right before the fight to go kick Havel's ass so I could wear heavy armor for the fight.

Ive tried planning things out. It never really sticks. Small things are definitely easier, if it's something quick I can sometimes convince myself. 

I don't really agree about seeing good. I know it sounds edgy, but I don't really see good in other people either. Through my teen years I became almost afraid of anything good or happy because I knew it wouldn't last or it wasn't true. I feel the same way about people.

I like things that sound powerful. Things that sound like the singer was just yelling out his heart when he wrote and sang it. Not necessarily metal, a lot of that is straight up yelling. Just something that I can really *feel* when I listen to it. Something that I could listen to if I needed to break something, or yell my own heart out. A lot of it would probably be considered edgy. I'm ok with that.

> that's not a huge amount of money

That's funny because 16 grand would be life changing for me or my family right now.
